question: restaurants within 500 meters of Belém Tower
sql: SELECT p.names.primary, p.basic_category, ST_AsGeoJSON(p.geometry) FROM lisbon_places p WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' AND ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM lisbon_places WHERE names.primary = 'Belém Tower')) <= 500

question: buildings intersecting the Tagus river
sql: SELECT b.names.primary, b.subtype, ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) FROM lisbon_buildings b WHERE ST_Intersects(b.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM lisbon_places WHERE names.primary = 'Tagus River'))

question: historic sites inside Alfama district polygon
sql: SELECT p.names.primary, p.taxonomy.primary FROM lisbon_places p WHERE p.taxonomy.primary = 'historic_site' AND ST_Within(p.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE names.primary = 'Alfama District Boundary'))

question: commercial buildings taller than 50m near Chiado metro station
sql: SELECT b.names.primary, b.height, b.subtype FROM lisbon_buildings b WHERE b.subtype = 'commercial' AND b.height > 50 AND ST_Distance_Sphere(b.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM lisbon_places WHERE names.primary = 'Chiado Metro Station')) < 300

question: parks touching residential areas
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.names.primary AS park_name, r.names.primary AS residential_area FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings r ON ST_Touches(p.geometry, r.geometry) WHERE p.taxonomy.primary = 'park' AND r.subtype = 'residential'

question: show footprints of buildings containing cafes
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places c ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE c.basic_category = 'cafe' GROUP BY b.id, b.geometry
